originalText:
CAN YOU BELIEVE CLAUDE CODE DID THIS? 🤯

A designer just dropped a showreel of client websites — every single one built with Claude Code.

Not mockups. Shipped, live, animated sites 👇

🎨 Kinetic typography that moves like a $10K agency intro
🏗️ Real client work: doors company, personal brands, product sites
⚡ The pipeline: from sketch to shipped — one tool, no handoff
🧠 “Own the whole stack” — design, code, motion, deploy

The setup behind work like this is stupidly simple:

curl -fsSL https://t.co/TwSPt2eanX | bash
npx skills add ppakaus/Impeccable

One install. One design skill. Then you describe the site like you’d brief a contractor — and Claude writes the layout, the animations, the responsive breakpoints.

💰 The math nobody wants to say out loud:

→ Agencies charge $3-10K per site like these
→ Claude Code ships one in an afternoon
→ The showreel IS the sales pitch — post your builds, clients come to you

Designers used to need developers.

Developers used to need designers.

Now one person with Claude Code is both 🚀

LET’S BUILD SOMETHING GOOD.
summary: Shows a motion or video generation demo associated with Claude Fable 5, based on the original post's media and description.
